title: Regulated system: validation evidence (GAMP 5 style), risk per requirement, audit trail
docs: Validation plan and protocols; the traceability matrix and validation report are added by VAL-02 and VAL-03 (GAMP 5 terms)
constraints: **Audit trail** on all important data; records are never silently overwritten. A change to an issued record produces a new revision.
Every requirement card has a `risk` level (`high`, `medium`, `low`) that sets the depth of its tests and protocol (`docs/validation/plan.md` §3).
Tests carry the requirement ID so the traceability matrix can be generated; a high-risk requirement needs both an automated test and a written protocol.
codeConventions: - Integration tests run on the real database engine, never an in-memory substitute.
- Synthetic data only in tests and demos; never client data.
testing: Test depth follows the requirement's `risk` (`docs/validation/plan.md` §3): a high-risk requirement has an automated test and an executed protocol in `docs/validation/protocols/`.
Test results of a release candidate are kept as validation evidence; they are never rerun over or edited.

phases.title: Validation
phases.goal: Protocols executed on the release candidate, traceability complete, validation report signed and the system declared fit for use. Closing condition of the project, not a gate.
